title: Gemini CLI: How To Get Started
summary: Getting-started guide for Gemini CLI: install, GEMINI.md context files, MCP to GitHub/Linear, free tier, 1M context.

assertions.quote: The free tier lets you use up to 60 requests per minute or up to 1000 requests per day

verdicts.note: At launch the free quota was unusually generous; Google later tightened limits and model routing, and 'capable' trailed Claude Code and Codex on many tasks.

assertions.quote: start off with an empty file ... as you ... run into behaviors that you want it to change, that's when you can update the context file

verdicts.note: Encoding lessons in rules and workflows does reduce repeat mistakes, but rule files bloat and conflict if not pruned; gains are real but not automatically compounding.

assertions.quote: a configuration file, which is essentially going to be a system prompt for your agent

verdicts.note: Persistent instruction files measurably steer agent behavior; overlong or contradictory ones reduce adherence.
